title: ITD District 2 Laboratory Heating Upgrades Rebid
scope: Complete ground truth for all nine supplied pages of the ITD District 2 heating-system-upgrades rebid set: project/sheet/scale review, every M3.0 schedule row and cell, schedule/plan reconciliation, printed control interface rows, network/control context, the written grey existing and bold updated sequence layers, and sensor/valve/actuator source limits. No unprinted installed I/O, controller, valve, damper-actuator, or zone-sensor quantity is invented.
reading_notes: The retained corpus has all nine pages of this supplied drawing set. Full-page Poppler renders establish page-level visual context; MuPDF and Poppler independently corroborate every authored schedule cell and bounded controls/reconciliation assertion.

M3.0 has 4 schedule tables / 11 line items: 1 existing AHU, 2 existing boilers, 6 new hydronic pumps, and 2 new VFDs. A schedule row is not automatically an installed drawing count; the 11 identities are separately anchored to plan/schematic context.

M4.0 and M4.1 explicitly say grey is existing control sequence and bold is updated control sequence. This record preserves both layers; it does not manufacture an integrated final control narrative where the source does not do so.

The only printed VFD and chiller points lists are open-ended interface lists. Their 16 visible source rows lack per-row AI/AO/DI/DO classifications and physical owner/multiplier data, so they are neither retyped nor inflated into a terminal count.

Legends, schematic transmitter/symbol marks, detail callouts, plan symbols, schedules and physical installed devices are distinct source constructs. Their quantities are retained only where the drawing set actually establishes them.

requirement_audit.finding: Project name, location, building description, agency, engineering firm, project number, rebid issue and issue date are captured; blank revision grids are not reclassified as revisions.

Every supplied sheet has a page-level sheet/title/review ledger. Sheet-ID/name lettering is visually legible outlined title-block graphics, so the source limitation is retained rather than asserting a false text-extraction witness.
The two M1.0 and two E1.0 plan views state 1/4" = 1'-0"; detail/controls/schedule pages are not distance-scaled plan views and no supplied page has a graphic scale bar.
All 11 M3.0 marked schedule identities are classified and reconciled to plan/schematic visual context. The BP-2 area-served source conflict remains explicit rather than corrected by assumption.
All four M3.0 schedules are retained as 11 exact source rows and 160 two-engine-corrobated cells, including airflow, capacity, flow, electrical, pump, VFD and selection fields.

Every visible row in the 4-row VFD and 12-row chiller interface lists is retained with its source scope. The lists are expressly open-ended and untyped, so no unsupported I/O-type or physical-terminal count is claimed.
Existing Delta system, BACnet, existing controller/operator components and explicitly absent transport/addressing/baud/controller-model information are recorded exactly at source scope.

M4.0 heating-water and M4.1 chilled-water written sequences are separated into existing-grey and updated-bold layers, with the VFD/chiller lists, key reset, delay, lead/lag, alarm, valve, UCP and diagram context retained.
Schematic/integration logical sensor roles are indexed. The supplied set does not map space, CO2 or smart-thermostat devices to zones, so physical counts remain explicitly not stated.

No valve/actuator schedules, no zone sensor roster, open-ended interface lists, outlined sheet-ID text, grey/bold layering, schedule-versus-installed distinctions and the BP-2 wording conflict are all explicitly recorded.
All nine supplied pages were reviewed at full-page resolution; the saved Poppler renders and each sheet finding are embedded and hash-checked in the final record.
Build and validation rerun every module against the retained MuPDF and Poppler source captures. The final record stores component and bundle digests in addition to the evidence source hash.

page_review.finding: G0.0 general cover: project identity, vicinity map and drawing index; no BAS schedule or point list.
M0.0 mechanical cover: abbreviations, legend and notes. Legend symbols are not treated as installed inventory.
M1.0 loft mechanical demolition and new-work plans: removed hot/chilled-water pumps, new HWP/BP/CWP/VFD context and AHU-1 3-way valve note.
M2.0 mechanical details: existing/new hot-water piping, boiler and heating-coil details; all detailed views marked not to scale.
M3.0 mechanical schedules: existing AHU/boilers and new pumps/VFDs; all four schedule tables transcribed.
M4.0 controls: legend, Delta architecture, heating-water schematic, grey existing and bold updated sequence layers, VFD points list.
M4.1 controls: chilled-water schematic, grey existing and bold updated sequence layers, open-ended chiller points list and BACnet panel label.
E0.0 electrical cover: legends, general notes and panel schedules; auxiliary electrical context, not a BAS point list.
E1.0 mechanical power plan: demolition/new power context for scheduled pumps/VFDs and related mechanical equipment.

verification_semantics: MuPDF and Poppler independently captured all nine supplied vector-PDF pages. Current authored schedule/point cells and bounded text assertions are rechecked in both engines at bundle build and validation time. Parser agreement corroborates the retained source text/cells and their bounds; full-page Poppler review establishes visual sheet disposition, symbol/line-weight relationships and source limitations. Neither process invents physical device, terminal, controller, valve, damper-actuator, or zone-sensor quantities not established by the supplied PDF.
